# Collect tracked working-tree source files

Scans the repository's tracked files (via `git ls-files`), reads each regular file from the working tree, and stages text files as source_file artifacts with SHA-256 content hashes. Binary files and non-regular entries are omitted.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/collectors/git.py` — `knowledge_compiler.collectors.git.GitCollector.collect_full`
